entries.06410d8a893dba10: This is an information exchange platform between local governments and private companies. Local governments can search and browse private companies' services according to their issues, and private companies can list information about services for local governments. The service started from the 27th fiscal period. Revenue is not separately disclosed.
entries.1a4fa3c094341c68: This administrative magazine is provided free of charge to local governments and local assembly members across Japan. It introduces cases and know-how that can be used in local government operations, and it offers private companies advertising placements in its pages. Revenue is not separately disclosed.

entries.3218aace88abea83: This business works with local governments to serve as a comprehensive consultation desk for vacant house owners, and proposes and provides services such as support for the circulation of low-priced vacant houses (¥0 property matching). Revenue is not separately disclosed.
entries.3743544ba19818ef: A company that contributes to securing revenue sources and reducing expenses for local governments through the sale of advertising space for local governments, the joint publication of information booklets, and support for public-private partnerships.
entries.3d0a7aa880ba4c65: This business aims to promote public-private partnerships. Using relationships with local governments built through its advertising business, it operates services that connect local governments and private companies. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,541 million, up 42.8% from the previous fiscal year. It is carried out by the consolidated subsidiary Jichitai Works Co., Ltd.
entries.5d4002f118ec3b3b: This business uses advertising space in media owned by local governments. It is carried out by the consolidated subsidiary Jichitai Ado Co., Ltd.
